Name: Colorful Paths for CP or AT
Author: NaoeaDri
Description:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077646255683014756/colorful-paths.png[/img]

You can choose between the Content Patcher version of the mod or the Alternative Textures version.


[b]The version for Content Patcher colors:[/b]

Cobblestone path in yellow, orange and cyan colors.
Crystal path in pink, lilac and cyan colors.
Stepping stone path in pink, yellow, lilac and blue colors.
Stone walkway floor in blue color.


[b]The version for Alternative Textures colors:[/b]

Cobblestone path in yellow, orange and cyan colors or in pink, lilac and cyan colors.
Crystal path in yellow, orange and cyan or in pink, lilac and cyan.
Stepping stone path in yellow or green or orange or lilac or blue or pink colors.
Stone walkway floor in blue color.


You have more freedom to decorate and choose the colors of the floor with the Alternative Textures version, but since I started having problems with this mod I am using the Content Patcher version.

Downloads.Description: You don't need Content Patcher to use this version, just Alternative Textures.
